assumptions.inputs: All baskets, amounts, margins and demand ratios are planning assumptions; no real business weights.
assumptions.policy: Policy-inspired f=3 scenario; assume an eligible low-value distance-sale consignment, one origin country and one parcel per successful purchase. H is an input, not a tariff classification decision.
assumptions.vat: Sales exclude output VAT; costs are net of assumed recoverable VAT. Recoverability is not verified for a real business.
assumptions.probability: Unknown 0<p_ref<=1 is common to REFERENCE and ABSORB; their comparison values stay at r=1. No price or content change means no assumed demand change from the cost shock alone.
assumptions.omitted: Nonrecoverable taxes, other handling charges, payment fees, refunds, inventory, acquisition, financing and long-run cannibalization are not modeled.
assumptions.demand: The fixed r grid is not a forecast or confidence interval. Equal r across actions is only a conditional comparison. Ratios above 1 require checking p_ref*r<=1.
